jobs.occupation: Technical Support SAP - Manufacturing - East Flanders
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated SAP Technical Support Specialist (junior to medior level) to support daily SAP operations in an international manufacturing environment. This role is ideal for someone with initial experience in SAP support who is eager to grow their technical skills while contributing to stable and efficient business processes.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide second-line SAP support to end users
• Handle incidents and service requests within agreed timelines
• Monitor SAP systems and report potential issues
• Assist in routine maintenance tasks and system checks
• Support testing activities during system changes or updates
• Document solutions and contribute to internal knowledge bases
• Escalate complex issues to senior experts when needed
• Collaborate with IT and business teams across different locations
• Help identify opportunities for process improvements

• 2-6 years of experience in IT support or SAP support (or relevant internship/traineeship)
• Basic understanding of SAP systems (S/4HANA knowledge is a plus but not required)
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
• Strong willingness to learn and develop new skills
• Good problem-solving and communication skills
• Organized and able to manage multiple tasks

Our client is a fast-growing Belgian company operating in the food industry. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, we are currently looking for an Application Analyst / Project Manager to strengthen their IT Applications team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on professional who enjoys working closely with end users, optimizing business applications, and contributing to the continuous improvement of business processes. 

Jobomschrijving

 As an Application Analyst / Project Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and continuous improvement of the company's business applications.

Acting as the first point of contact for application-related issues, you will support users, coordinate improvements, and contribute to the evolution of the organization's application landscape:

• Manage and maintain business applications.
• Follow up on change requests, software updates, and application improvement initiatives.
• Contribute to reporting, data management, and process optimization projects.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners across multiple sites.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the IT applications environment.
• Provide first-line support to internal users for business applications.
• Analyze and resolve application-related incidents, escalating where necessary.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in application support, application management, functional analysis, or a similar role.
• Experience working with ERP systems.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (FSCM) and/or Navision is considered a strong asset.
• Experience with or interest in Power BI, reporting solutions, and EDI/API integrations is a plus.
• Service-oriented mindset with a genuine willingness to help end users.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive, hands-on, and capable of taking ownership.
• Team player with excellent communication skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is a fast-growing B2B organization investing heavily in the optimization of its digital landscape. As part of this transformation, they are looking for a Freelance IT Business Process Lead to analyze, redesign, and document key business processes, with a strong focus on e-commerce and IT systems.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Business Process Lead your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and map end-to-end business processes across multiple departments.
• Assess the interaction between business processes and IT systems.
• Redesign and optimize workflows to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
• Document business processes, functional flows, and system interactions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional process designs.
• Act as the interface between Business, IT, and external implementation partners.
• Support digital transformation projects related to e-commerce platforms and business applications.
• Ensure process governance, standardization, and adoption across the organization.
• Identify opportunities for automation and continuous process improvement.

A successful Freelance Business Process Lead should have:

• Proven experience as an IT Business Process Lead, Functional Analyst, or Process Consultant.
• Mandatory experience within a B2B e-commerce environment.
• Hand-on experience with Shopify or Magento is a great advantage.
• Strong understanding of business processes, system integrations, and digital workflows.
• Experience documenting business processes, functional specifications, and user journeys.
• Fluent in French and English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Executive Assistant - International law firm (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Our client is an international law firm based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide high-level administrative support to senior professionals, including complex calendar management, correspondence handling, preparation of presentations, and phone support.
• Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including transportation, accommodation, meeting logistics, and expense management.
• Organize and coordinate meetings, conferences, networking events, and client-related activities.
• Manage and maintain electronic and paper records, ensuring accurate filing and document management.
• Handle extensive email management, prioritizing communications and responding to requests when appropriate.
• Support the billing process, including the preparation, review, and follow-up of invoices.
• Prepare and process a significant volume of complex billing activities, requiring accuracy, attention to detail, and strong analytical skills.
• Maintain databases, contact lists, and administrative records.
• Provide ad hoc administrative support and assist with various projects as required.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Senior Administrative Assistant role.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English (spoken and written). Trilingual proficiency is essential.
• Excellent command of the Microsoft Office Suite.
• Advanced knowledge of Excel is required, including the ability to work with complex spreadsheets, data management, reporting, and billing-related tasks.
• Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with stakeholders at all levels.
• Able to remain calm under pressure and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, flexible, and service-oriented team player.

Additional RequirementGiven the volume and complexity of the invoicing responsibilities, our client is specifically seeking someone with strong billing experience and the ability to manage complex invoicing processes efficiently and accurately.

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

As a bus technician, you become part of a dynamic team specializing in the maintenance and repair of both traditional and electric buses. You combine mechanical knowledge with electrical and electronic expertise, and get the opportunity to deepen your skills even further. You'll work alongside colleagues who, like you, want to move forward in this evolving sector.

A typical day includes preparing new vehicles for delivery, performing maintenance and repairs, and diagnosing electric buses using software and measurement systems. You'll help with breakdowns, carry out interventions on location, and ensure all completed work is accurately registered in the system. Regular meetings with the workshop supervisor and teammates ensure a smooth workflow and the necessary support.

Are you ready to take your technical skills to the next level and become part of a fast-evolving sector? Apply today and make a difference in a growing team!

• You have at least a lower or higher secondary education diploma, preferably in a technical field

• At least 2 years of relevant work experience in a technical position with buses, trucks, vans, or electricity

• Strong knowledge of mechanics and electricity; experience with diagnostics and electronic vehicles is a plus

• You can work independently, take initiative, and have a hands-on attitude

• You are eager to learn and want to grow in the electric vehicle sector

• You have a category B driver’s license

• You have good verbal and written skills in Dutch or English

• Plus: HEV technician certificate (E2/E3) or willingness to obtain, and category D driver’s license

• You are flexible, reliable, and result-oriented

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

For a leading company active in the housing and real estate sector, we are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.
Your responsibilities
As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization
• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes
• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions
• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings
• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines
• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment
In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential
• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems
• Fluent communication skills in English
• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues
• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus
You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.
